body: You can eat a whole bag of chips and still be hungry again in an hour, so keep protein snacks around instead. youtube_description:
Snack on protein, not on carbs.

You can eat a whole bag of chips and still be hungry again in an hour, so keep protein snacks around instead. Beef jerky, sardines, Greek yogurt, cottage cheese or a few slices of deli turkey are all options, and most of these are 100 to 150 calories with 15 to 20 grams of protein. It's very, very hard to overeat sardines or cottage cheese because you get full and you stop.

Save this for the next time you buy snacks.
